Summary: Compass Meridian is building a compliance research assistant for regulatory reporting and internal audits. Sensitive PII and client documents must remain in EU jurisdiction; strict retention/audit trail requirements. They favored Dedicated inside VPC or Private install with customer-managed KMS.

What we shared: architecture options, SOC2 artifacts, proposed BYOK KMS flow, POC success criteria (latency p50<250ms, 95% coverage on retrieval tasks), and pilot SOW draft. SE recommended continuous prefix caching + compact model variant for low-latency reranking.

Signals: High interest initially; Security and Legal heavily involved. Procurement announced a budget freeze on 11/30 (internal memo referenced). Champion (Lead ML Engineer Tomasz K.) went on leave 12/05 and no deputy assigned. Security repeatedly emphasized "We cannot accept vendor keys outside EU" and asked for HSM placement details.

Why stalled: combination of budget freeze, champion unavailability, and unresolved HSM/KMS residency questions. Competitors (Anthropic/OpenAI via Azure) offered quicker paperwork and hosted KMS options, which reduced customer's appetite to continue deep technical evaluation.

Engagement attempts: 4 follow-up emails (11/28, 12/08, 12/12, 12/18), one voicemail to CTO (12/19), and SE proposed a security deep dive (no takers). Recommended playbook: (1) send concise exec one-pager linking compliance risk mitigation to pilot ROI; (2) offer transient technical escrow options and a security SLA; (3) pause cadence and set nurture re-check in 8 weeks; (4) keep SOC2 and HSM materials current for quick re-engagement.

Quotes captured: "We can't accept keys that leave the EU perimeter" (Head of Security). "Budget is frozen until Q1 headcount & cloud spend review completes" (VP of Finance).

Disposition: Stalled after discovery. Move to nurture pipeline (touch every 6-8 weeks). Re-open when champion returns or procurement signals budget window.
